Aria: Quick note — edge ESM sample lost Authorization header after esbuild minify; CJS fine. Repro attached.
Tom: Can you paste tsconfig + bundler flags?
Aria: module=ESNext, target=ES2022, preserveValueImports:false, esModuleInterop:true, esbuild minify=true. Call: client.fetch('/api', { auth: token, headers:{ 'x-c': '1' } }) -> in bundle headers.Authorization undefined, 401 -> SDK retries.
Nina: Sounds like a value-import / type-only overload got erased by the bundler. Overloads that exist only in types can lead to different emitted helpers and drop forwarded args.
Tom: Do you have emitted JS around the request helper? If opts/auth becomes undefined in the emitted impl, it's an emit quirk not runtime.
Aria: Emitted snippet from ESM bundle: `export function send(u,o){o=o||{};const h=o.headers||{};/* o.auth missing */}` — in CJS the same fn includes `h.Authorization = o.auth.token`.
Nina: Quick workarounds: set `preserveValueImports=true` or disable minify; or make wrapper runtime-visible (avoid type-only overloads).
Tom: For SDK: avoid purely type-only forwarding wrappers for exported helpers. Add a compile-time test: tsc + esbuild of minimal TS that asserts emitted JS retains options forwarding.
Aria: I'll add a short note in devex samples "ESM bundling: missing auth" with repro and configs that work. Also opening a tiny PR to add the test.
BuildBot: CI: edge-esm-auth-repro #12 failed on node 20 (repro shows missing header) :warning:
